title: Binding of the owner.com marketing design-repo to the N0 common SaaS design-constraint policy

classification.marketModel: vertical B2B SaaS: restaurants (independent operators) pay a monthly subscription (Flat / Flex plans) for websites, online ordering, POS, marketing automation and a reporting dashboard. Diners use the restaurants' branded sites and apps, but the marketing site's buyer is the restaurant owner.

evidence.claim: pricing tiers sold as a subscription: 'Lower subscription with a small per-order fee'
FAQ: Flat plan = monthly subscription, Flex plan = lower subscription + per-order fee
customer login goes to a hosted web app (dashboard.owner.com)
product = one dashboard of sales, SEO rankings, reviews and order sources
audience is restaurant businesses ('a must-have for succeeding online as an independent restaurant')
sales-led conversion: 'Get a free demo' (template.demo, template.group-4)

classification.notConsumer: Not a consumer app or a marketplace: there is no diner-facing account, no two-sided matching and no app-store download for diners on this site; the branded apps are a product the restaurant buys.

generationRules: PageSpecs declare mode clone | generation (schema/pagespec.schema.json). Generation pages may not contain owner.com identity, copy, claims, people, restaurant customers, source routes/URLs, live embeds or clone-only / blocked assets (schema/semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_*; patterns in schema/source-identity.json built from the clone source; availability pinned in code).
Pages are composed only from the 26 templates and 80 section contracts; template node lists, compatibility rules and per-field word budgets are enforced (match_template, compatibility/graph.json).
Pricing / demo / conversion blocks keep their CTA or HERO classing; ratings, review counts, '#1 rated' marks and numeric growth claims are never fabricated or copied (GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM).
Style references are catalog tokens only (TOKEN_* rules in semantic_validate.py; tokens/llm/token-policy.json).
Runtime UI (the /demo overlay modal, hidden A/B control) is never retrievable content (PINNED_RETRIEVAL); no section may hold most of a page (extraction/wrapper_gate.py over measured heights).
contentHashNote: registry.manifest.json designPolicy.contentHash = sha256 over the files listed in enforcedBy (sorted by path; each contributes its path, a NUL byte, its bytes and a NUL byte). verify_all.py recomputes it. The text of the common policy n0-saas-design-constraints-common itself is not shipped in this repo and was not available to this build; the hash covers this repo's enforcing files, not the common policy document.

approval.note: Classification (vertical B2B SaaS for restaurants) is an agent decision from the evidence above (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify the binding.
